Don't mate. There are many of us who are going thru same as you. In fact I admire you for having the courage to speak up publicly about it.

After my 2nd watch on Saturday, I was thinking back of how much trauma Thor has undergone since the start of Ragnarok. First he finds out Loki has tricked everyone and Odin is lost on earth. Then he loses Odin, immediately hela attacks (and he gets to know he has a blood thirsty sister), becomes a prisoner on sakaar, has to fight hela, has to destroy his home to save his people and then gets attacked by Thanos. I mean that's a lot to take. Not to count what follows for him.....
Peter was standing at the forefront just behind Rhodes and Hogan if memory serves me right. Fury was at the back on the balcony. It is quite likely Peter didn't get introduced to him.
That probably must have hurt him the most. That he missed the chance to end it all in time
Essentially he wasn't there when maw and cull obsidian invaded NY. Leading on to titan and so so on....
